body: Release log = LogPlugin::fmt_layer tee (stderr + gta_like.log next to exe, no ANSI), not file-only: QA brp.py release runs and Linux terminal users keep stderr. Console hidden gated statically by a PE Subsystem==2 check in package/verify instead of only the runtime boot.

Fatal-error dialog: recommend windows-sys =0.52.0 (already in Cargo.lock via winit with Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging) over a hand-written user32 extern block or a dialog crate; one static LOG_FILE opened at the top of main instead of inside log_layer.

Smoke console scan checks only `panicked` (PANIC_LINE), not the full ERROR|panicked rule: the console is a tee of the same tracing events as gta_like.log, so an ERROR scan there would only duplicate file findings; panics are the console-only channel. Scan moved into a pure log_problems() so the flip is a unit row, not a game boot.

Closing the MessageBoxW error dialog with PostMessage(WM_COMMAND, IDOK, lParam=0) does nothing: the process stayed alive (exit code 259) and looked like a post-dialog hang. BM_CLICK on the OK button or WM_SYSCOMMAND SC_CLOSE closes it and the game exits 1. Harness artefact, not a product bug.
